title: Influence-based Online Experience Selection for Effective RLHF
authors_zh: Yifan Gong, Jing Yao, Xiting Wang, Xunlong Wang, Xiaoyuan Yi, Xing Xie
paper_type_zh: 目标感知的在线 RLHF 经验选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建 RLHF 系统、需要删除无关或奖励受污染 rollout，同时保留标准强化学习优化器兼容性的读者。
one_line: InfOES filters online RLHF experiences by their estimated influence on an objective-specific validation return before every policy update.
InfOES 在每次策略更新前，按在线 RLHF 经验对目标特定验证回报的估计影响筛选经验。
why: It directly connects each training experience to the gradient of the desired alignment objective instead of relying on generic difficulty or length heuristics.
inclusion_reason: It makes the contribution of a live rollout experience to a stated alignment objective decide whether that experience updates the policy.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Online RLHF normally updates on every collected rollout, although some experiences are irrelevant to the stated alignment objective or carry incorrect reward feedback. Static pruning cannot respond to the changing policy, and heuristics such as length, perplexity, or difficulty do not say whether a particular rollout moves the policy toward helpfulness or harmlessness.

The paper asks how to decide, at every RL round, which experiences deserve to update the policy. It estimates each experience's local effect on an objective-specific validation return and filters experiences with negative influence. The selection decision is thus tied to the intended policy improvement, not merely to an intrinsic property of a prompt or response.

在线 RLHF 通常使用每条收集到的 rollout 更新模型，尽管有些经验与所述对齐目标无关，或带有错误的奖励反馈。静态剪枝不能响应不断变化的策略，而长度、困惑度或难度等启发式指标也不能说明某个 rollout 是否使策略更接近有帮助或无害的目标。

论文要回答的是，在每轮强化学习中如何决定哪些经验值得更新策略。它估计每条经验对目标特定验证回报的局部影响，并过滤负影响经验。因此，选择决策与预期策略改进相连，而不是只依赖提示或回答的内在属性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
InfOES treats a rollout buffer as a temporary attribution problem. Within one fixed policy round, the validation gradient describes the desired improvement and each experience has an RL-objective gradient. Their inner product estimates whether optimizing that experience will increase or decrease a surrogate return on the validation objective.

This makes the validation set an explicit declaration of what the training consumer should optimize. Experiences above the influence threshold enter PPO, GRPO, or REINFORCE++ updates; those below it do not. Rather than claiming every hard sample is useful, the method permits objective-irrelevant math or code rollouts and reward-corrupted safety rollouts to be excluded when they conflict with the chosen objective.

InfOES 将 rollout 缓冲区视为一个临时归因问题。在一个固定策略轮次中，验证梯度描述期望的改进，每条经验都有一个强化学习目标梯度。两者的内积估计优化该经验会提高还是降低验证目标上的代理回报。

这使验证集成为训练消费者应优化什么的明确声明。高于影响阈值的经验进入 PPO、GRPO 或 REINFORCE++ 更新，低于阈值的则不会。方法并不宣称每个困难样本都有用；当它们与选择的目标冲突时，目标无关的数学或代码 rollout，以及奖励受污染的安全 rollout 都可被排除。

title: Method
方法
html:
At the start of a round, the current policy greedily generates responses for a small validation set and computes an advantage-weighted log-probability surrogate return. Its average gradient is the objective feature. The policy then collects ordinary rollout experiences containing state, action, reward, log probability, value, and advantage; the RL gradient of each experience is paired with the validation feature to obtain its influence score.

Experiences above a threshold are retained for the policy update. The main experiments use harmlessness and helpfulness validation prompts from PKU-SafeRLHF, a TinyLlama reward model trained on seven public preference sources, and a threshold that discards the least influential 15% in each round. The selector is plugged into OpenRLHF implementations of PPO, GRPO, and REINFORCE++ with LoRA.

在一个轮次开始时，当前策略为一个小验证集贪心生成回答，并计算以优势加权的对数概率代理回报。其平均梯度就是目标特征。随后策略收集普通 rollout 经验，其中含有状态、动作、奖励、对数概率、价值和优势；每条经验的强化学习梯度与验证特征配对，得到影响分数。

高于阈值的经验被保留用于策略更新。主要实验使用来自 PKU-SafeRLHF 的无害性和有帮助性验证提示、一个在七个公开偏好来源上训练的 TinyLlama 奖励模型，以及每轮丢弃最不具影响力 15% 经验的阈值。选择器被接入 OpenRLHF 的 PPO、GRPO 和 REINFORCE++ 实现，并使用 LoRA。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across TinyLlama-1.1B and Alpaca-7B, three datasets, two alignment objectives, and PPO, GRPO, and REINFORCE++, InfOES improves the reported average test reward over the corresponding standard algorithm. In direct selector comparisons, it reaches 3.72 versus 3.39 for the strongest baseline on TinyLlama and 4.31 versus 3.97 on Alpaca, with the largest relative gain on the mixed-domain dataset.

The paper also measures saved optimization steps: across the listed settings, InfOES reaches the best standard-training performance with about 18.5–22.2% fewer steps on Alpaca and 19.4–21.8% fewer on TinyLlama. Ablations show that high-influence subsets train best while low-influence subsets can underperform the untrained base model. These results support objective-aware online selection, but use small models and reward-based alignment evaluations.

在 TinyLlama-1.1B 和 Alpaca-7B、三个数据集、两个对齐目标以及 PPO、GRPO、REINFORCE++ 上，InfOES 都提高了相对于对应标准算法所报告的平均测试奖励。在直接选择器比较中，它在 TinyLlama 上达到 3.72，而最强基线为 3.39；在 Alpaca 上达到 4.31，而最强基线为 3.97，最大相对收益出现在混合领域数据集。

论文还测量了节省的优化步数：在所列设置中，InfOES 以约少 18.5–22.2% 的步数达到 Alpaca 上标准训练的最佳性能，以少 19.4–21.8% 的步数达到 TinyLlama 上的最佳性能。消融显示，高影响子集训练最好，而低影响子集甚至会低于未训练基础模型。这些结果支持目标感知的在线选择，但使用的是较小模型和基于奖励的对齐评测。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The key novelty is to make online experience selection answer an optimization question: does this experience's policy gradient align with the validation-return gradient for the declared objective? This is more specific than ranking prompts by generic difficulty, length, or uncertainty, because the same rollout can be useful for one objective and harmful for another.

It also turns a validation set from a passive evaluation artifact into a consumer specification for data. The method filters records while the policy and its rollout distribution change, instead of fixing a selected dataset before RL begins. This creates an auditable link from alignment goal to experience score to policy update.

关键新意是让在线经验选择回答一个优化问题：这条经验的策略梯度是否与所声明目标的验证回报梯度对齐。这比按通用难度、长度或不确定性给提示排序更具体，因为同一个 rollout 对一个目标可能有用，对另一个目标却可能有害。

它还将验证集从被动的评测制品变成数据的消费者规范。方法在策略及其 rollout 分布变化的过程中筛选记录，而不是在强化学习开始前固定一个选择后的数据集。这建立了一条从对齐目标、到经验分数、再到策略更新的可审计链条。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method has not been evaluated on 32B-or-larger models, multi-objective alignment, mathematics, or code generation. It depends on a reward model and a validation set that faithfully represent the intended objective; noise there can cause beneficial rollouts to be filtered. Per-experience gradient attribution also adds computational and storage overhead, and local per-round influence is not a guarantee of long-horizon global improvement. The paper declares future code availability, so implementation details and all upstream data licenses require verification before reuse.
该方法尚未在 32B 或更大模型、多目标对齐、数学或代码生成上评估。它依赖能够忠实表示预期目标的奖励模型和验证集；其中的噪声可能让有益 rollout 被过滤。逐经验梯度归因还会增加计算和存储开销，而每轮的局部影响也不能保证长时程的全局改进。论文声明未来发布代码，因此复用前仍需核验实现细节和所有上游数据许可证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This is essential for RLHF builders who need a principled alternative to applying every rollout or relying on prompt difficulty. It offers a precise record schema and selection rule that can be attached to several existing RL optimizers, and is especially valuable in mixed prompt pools where objectives conflict. Before adoption, define the validation objective, audit reward-model error, compare thresholds against a no-filter baseline, and measure wall-clock overhead rather than assuming saved optimization steps always reduce total cost.
对于需要有原则地替代“使用每个 rollout”或依赖提示难度的 RLHF 构建者，这是一篇必读论文。它提供精确的记录结构和选择规则，可附着在多个现有强化学习优化器上，在目标相互冲突的混合提示池中尤其有价值。采用前应定义验证目标、审计奖励模型错误、将阈值与无过滤基线比较，并测量实际墙钟开销，而不要假定节省优化步数总会降低总成本。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 4–6 as one chain. Section 4 defines a local, round-level influence rather than a global attribution; Section 5 establishes the objective-specific validation data, threshold, reward model, and compatible optimizers; Section 6 tests whether the score actually separates helpful from harmful experience subsets. The mixed-domain result is particularly useful because it demonstrates why objective-unrelated prompts can be bad training data even when their rewards look normal. Preserve the reference-policy snapshot and validation-generation rule in any reproduction.
应将第 4 至第 6 节作为一条链阅读。第 4 节定义的是局部、轮次级影响，而非全局归因；第 5 节确定目标特定验证数据、阈值、奖励模型和兼容优化器；第 6 节检验该分数是否确实将有益与有害经验子集分开。混合领域结果尤其有用，因为它说明即使奖励看似正常，目标无关提示也可能是糟糕的训练数据。任何复现都应保留参考策略快照和验证生成规则。
